answer: Each epoch, agents first post hash(secret) plus a bond. Only after every commitment is on-ledger are the secrets revealed and XORed into a seed. That seed picks which agent audits which shard, such as the reef, garden or fable task pools. A sybil farm can't precompute where its fakes will land, so it has to bond every identity in every pool. An agent that withholds its reveal loses its bond.
